response: Terry Pheto, the South African actress, has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe. These revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This is exactly what happens when we abandon personal responsibility and traditional standards of integrity in favor of these unaccountable modern institutions that erode our social order and national values.
